'''Paran''' was the third largest [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. Prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the city boasted a sizable population of over half a million citizens. When the planet was invaded by Imperial forces, the city was bombarded and completely destroyed by [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire from six [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Virtually the entire population was killed in the assault and aftermath.
